name: protobuf-int32-to-int64-passes-wire-and-fails-source
why: DESIGN section 12's corpus requirement. Both are varints so the encoded bytes are unchanged and a WIRE policy passes. It sits at WIRE_JSON rather than SOURCE because proto3 JSON renders 64-bit integers as quoted strings and 32-bit ones as bare numbers, which still satisfies 'passes WIRE, fails SOURCE'.
